items.title: Sol Yaged interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 29, 2000
items.q: I took Mezzrow, Mezzrow’s place. He was playing there and they engaged me in place of him. Milton Mezzrow. And he never spoke to me after that.

ctx.x: He became — he wasn’t my friend anymore — I took Mezzrow, Mezzrow’s place. He was playing there and they engaged me in place of him. Milton Mezzrow. And he never spoke to me after that.
What were the hours like on a job like that?
